_discord_ping_note: Discord pings by user ID, not username. Replace discord_ping with your numeric Discord user ID in the form <@123456789>. To get it: enable Developer Mode in Discord settings, right-click your name -> Copy User ID. Empty string = no ping, just a message.
_accounts_note: Each account only needs an identifier: the exact FACEIT nickname (case-sensitive), a profile URL (https://www.faceit.com/en/players/...), or a GUID — any of these fields works. The script resolves it to the GUID automatically and writes it back here.
